name: Car Soccer
author: Unity Play
description:
It is a Unity-based game where players can play soccer by driving cars.
Almost all game mechanics and all assets are created by me.
The game currently includes a single-player mode with AI-controlled cars, offering various match setups such as 1v1, 2v2 (with an AI teammate), or uneven matches like 2v1 and 1v2.
The creation of the game is documented in a YouTube video series, where you can see almost the entire process of building the game from scratch.
Through the video series, I prepare game models, textures, scripts, and the integration of sound and music, as well as the implementation of single-player capabilities.
I am planning to create a multiplayer mode in the future.
For now, have fun playing against AI players.

Game Engine: Unity 2021.3.10f1 (URP - Universal Render Pipeline)
Models: Created by author
Music: Composed by author
SFX: Created by author

Game trailer: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Y7XOpJctwVQ
